source: Dake, 'Setting Up & Using the B:7X Metal-Cutting Bandsaw' (YouTube cJQ-KRT1hWw), 360p (the 720p stream refused the download), downloaded through downr.org to C:\jigged-data\footage\ and analysed locally with MediaPipe Hand Landmarker; the video is not in the repo
method: trainual's motion/extract_hands.py, then its analyze_timing.py segmenting restricted to the windows where the saw is used; the video is edited, so only uncut shots give durations

observed.what: One hand slides a rectangular tube along the infeed rollers and the bed into the vise: about 4.5 s, the shot ending as it arrives.
A hand turns the vise handwheel; the shot cuts while it is still turning, so at least 2.5 s.
The bow is lowered by its handle, which carries the trigger switch: the B:7X is a manual-feed saw, unlike a hydraulic-feed 9 x 16.
The cut piece picked up off the bed by hand after the cut.

used_for: bandsaw-cut-to-length: #6 the bar slide (4.5 s, one hand) and #8 the vise handwheel (2.5 s, a lower bound)
